text:
This photo shows an almost empty tray, so most of the food has already been eaten. Only small remnants are left: a few crumbs on the left plate, a few small pieces of what looks like cheese or fat on the right plate, and a wrapper. The drinks (juice and water) are not on a plate, so I excluded them. Counting only the remnants:

- Crumbs on the left plate: about 2 g, roughly 8 kcal.
- Cheese or similar remnants on the right plate: about 5 g, roughly 15 kcal.

That comes to about 7 g of food and about 23 kcal. This is a rough visual estimate.
